data.overview: Lovaskin is a Swiss family-run skincare brand (operated by Novellia Beauty AG / Novellia Europe sprl) best known for its Instant Foot Peel. The only brand-specific sources available are Lovaskin's own websites, which claim its products are vegan, cruelty-free, made in Switzerland, and free of parabens, sulfates, phthalates and other harsh chemicals. No independent assessments, third-party certifications, or legal/regulatory matters concerning the brand appear in the fetched sources.

claims.claim: Lovaskin states its products are vegan and free of parabens, sulfates, phthalates, dyes and petrolatum.
claims.quote: LOVASKIN products are vegan, free of parabens, sulfates, phthalates, dyes and petrolatum.

claims.claim: Lovaskin states its foot peel is completely cruelty-free and not tested on animals.
claims.quote: Vegan and cruelty-free: Made without harsh chemicals, parabens or phthalates, and completely cruelty-free.

claims.claim: Lovaskin claims to create high-quality products that work as promised, made in Switzerland to high standards.
claims.quote: Everything is made in Switzerland with the highest quality standards and using the best ingredients science and nature have to offer.

claims.claim: Lovaskin claims to avoid harsh chemicals and use safe, potent ingredients from nature and science.
claims.quote: Using safe, potent and fast-acting ingredients, LOVASKIN was born by combining the best of science and nature to actually care for your body.
